name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LinearVerif.sph_perfect_hiding
title: Linear hash-proof encryption is perfectly hiding on unsatisfiable linear checks
statement: Over a finite field, if M *v pi = v has no solution, then for every a and all t, t', the number of keys k with k^T M = a and k . v = t equals the number with k^T M = a and k . v = t'. Hence for a uniform key the hash k . v is uniform given the projected key k^T M, and the ciphertext (k^T M, k . v + mu) hides mu perfectly.
